close_reason: fixed: create role check excludes roles vacated in same request's update pass
description: handle_mailbox_set (mailbox.rs): the create loop role uniqueness check (L461-463) does not subtract roles_actually_vacated. If pass-1 vacates a role (e.g., folderA sets role=null freeing 'inbox'), the create loop still sees the pre-mutation snapshot showing 'inbox' as taken, and incorrectly rejects a create with role='inbox' with invalidProperties. Trigger: Mailbox/set request with update={X: role:null} + create={name:'Y', role:'inbox'} where X previously held role 'inbox' → create is wrongly rejected even though the role was freed in the same request.
title: Mailbox/set: create+update in same request can claim identical role
